resolution.observed_code: Validator requires source_family in addy/matt/superpowers and both canonical family checker and manifest keys, then checks all declared input hashes. Three emitters provide these identities.

focused_tests.command: rtk proxy python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_andino_unified.py -q

actual_report_baseline.methodology: Loaded the three current family manifests and procedural reports; computed current checker/manifest hashes and actual current GUIDE/resource hashes from the runtime, then called the validator with all57 methods and records.

adversarial_probes.command: rtk proxy python -B -c <read-only in-memory validate_method_evidence calls>
adversarial_probes.methodology: Deep-copied the actual report set, removed exactly one checker or manifest key from one family at a time, held all other report and runtime state constant, and required the exact missing-input error. No source/report was mutated.
